name: GST calculator
summary: Add or remove GST from a price
author: friday-core
description: Adds GST to a price or extracts it from a GST-inclusive price, and splits it into CGST and SGST (same state) or IGST (other state). Money is kept in paise so the parts add up. Common rates since 22 September 2025 are 0, 5, 18 and 40 percent; the right rate depends on the item's HSN or SAC code and is never guessed from a product name. If no rate is given, 18 percent is used and flagged.
